description.value: Pomeroy Inn & Suites is a hotel in Chetwynd, Northern BC, providing accommodation along North Access Road. Part of the Pomeroy Inn & Suites chain, it serves as a commercial lodging option for travelers in the northern region. Contact the hotel directly for information about bike storage and services for cycling tourists.
